steps.action: Revoke the exposed DB_ADMIN_KEY immediately so it can no longer be used by the agent or any service.
steps.quote: Revoke the exposed key immediately in the secrets manager or the provider's console.

steps.action: Create a replacement database key scoped only to the intended need, preferably read-only and short-lived.
steps.quote: Issue a new key limited to the intended use, read-only if possible, with a short lifetime.

steps.action: Remove DB_ADMIN_KEY from .env.admin and any repository or agent workspace files where it is present.
steps.quote: Remove the secret from every file of the repository and of the agents' workspace, .env files included.

steps.action: Review DB_ADMIN_KEY usage logs from the moment it was read, including the observed run_sql query, and investigate anomalies.
steps.quote: Review the old key's usage logs to spot any abnormal use since it was exposed.
